Elegant Villa -Style Duplex in Highly Sought after Umhlali Country Club and Golf Estate

This move in ready elegant freehold villa-style three-bedroom duplex is situated in the highly popular family-focused, pet-friendly Umhlali Country Club and Golf Estate delivering a lifestyle that blends the calm of estate living with the convenience of leisure amenities and a vibrant community spirit.

The front door entry leads into a very spacious open plan living area with the lounge section opening on both sides to the outdoors, one onto the garden and the other onto the generously sized covered verandah complete with a stylish built in braai.

The modern kitchen occupies a designated space and offers that offers a breakfast counter, generous cupboards and storage drawers with an out of sight scullery area and convenient outdoor access. Adding another dimension to the home`s entertaining appeal is a custom-built bar room with outdoor access , providing a sophisticated touch for both casual and formal entertaining.

A graceful staircase links the ground floor to the upper-level leading into a very large office/TV Room area. This lounge/office opens onto an outdoor balcony that offers panoramic vistas and is complemented by three bedrooms. The air-conditioned master bedroom has a full en suite bathroom, a large picture window that offer stunning estate and golf course views and it also has outdoor access onto the shared upper-level balcony.

Additional features of this 287 square metre home include, a double automated garage, ample driveway parking, a neat garden, and fibre internet.

Residents also enjoy use of an impressive offering which includes padel courts, a gym, a restaurant, golf, tennis, squash, and bowls. With all this to enjoy this stylish residence offers an exceptional lifestyle for those who appreciate both relaxation and an active, outdoor-oriented way of living. The positioning of Umhlali County Club also offers easy access to the N2 highway and Ballito’s extensive retail amenities.
